summary: trivago N.V. filed a Form 6-K announcing its 2026 annual general meeting of shareholders, scheduled for June 26, 2026, in Amsterdam. The agenda includes routine items such as adoption of statutory annual accounts, appointment of external auditor, re-appointment of managing directors, and discharge of liability. No special-situation event—such as a merger, tender offer, going-private, or activist campaign—is present. The filing is a standard notice of a routine shareholder meeting, not a special situation. There is no deal terms or premium discussed.
